Title: MegaForm for Umbraco
Description: A complete visual form and application builder for Umbraco 17 LTS. Start quickly with 31 bundled QuickStart templates or the searchable Online Gallery, create and edit forms with AI, build multi-page wizards, publish multilingual experiences, accept payments, manage submissions, and automate work with approvals, email, webhooks, retry history, and C# after-submission actions. Sales and support: daoa@dnndefender.com.
